title: Endpoint wizard — error states, UX notes, and copy draft
body:
Context:
This doc collects wireframe-level notes, error state handling, and microcopy drafts for the Endpoint Creation Wizard. Purpose is to capture UX-first handling of model pinning / version selection and the set of failure modes we need to show to customers, with clear recovery actions. This is a working artifact for product + design + eng to iterate on.

Primary goals:
- Make model selection and pinning explicit but low-friction for new users.
- Surface reliability implications (fallbacks, SLA tiers) at decision points without blocking fast onboarding.
- Define copy for transient and permanent error states that guides recovery.
- Prioritize graceful defaults for common orgs so most people can click through.

Audience:
- PMs and designers validating flow copy + edge cases.
- Frontend and backend engineers implementing UI states and telemetry.
- Solutions engineers who will demo the flow.

High-level flow summary (wireframe steps):
1) Choose endpoint template (Streaming / Request-response / Embeddings) — dropdown with short descriptions.
2) Pick model: search box with list; model card includes name, last-tested latency, recommended quantization. "Pin version" checkbox on the card.
3) Deployment settings: region, instance class (dedicated/hosted), autoscale min/max.
4) Preflight checks & compatibility panel: small pass/fail matrix for selected model + settings.
5) Review & create: summary with cost estimate and fallback policy.
6) Creation progress with live logs + invite to Console view.

Wireframe notes and behavior details:
- Model card microcopy: under model name show three inline chips: "latency: 40–70ms (est)", "cost: $0.003/tk (est)", "verified-seq: 2048". Chip text must be short.
- Pinning affordance: when user toggles "Pin version" show a tooltip: "Pinning locks this endpoint to a specific model artifact. Use when you need stable outputs. Updates will not be applied automatically." Include a small link: "When to pin?" that opens a modal with examples.
- Default behavior: for first-time users, Pin version is OFF; system recommends pin for production endpoints created from canary builds.
- Preflight compatibility panel: rows include Model-size vs. Instance-class, KV-cache support, Streaming enabled (y/n), Quantized (y/n). Each row has status icons: green/amber/red. Clicking a row expands inline logs or guidance.
- Cost estimate: provide low/med/high cost bands based on traffic template. Link to Optimize suggestions if costs look high.

Error states and copy drafts (grouped by recovery pattern):
A) Transient provisioning errors (retryable)
- UI state: banner with spinner + explanation when agent pool delayed.
- Copy: "Provisioning delayed — we couldn't start the GPU instances yet. We're retrying automatically. If this continues, try switching region or instance class, or contact support."
- CTA: single button: "Try different region" and secondary small link: "Open support chat".

B) Incompatible selection (blocking)
- UI state: sticky inline error next to the setting that caused failure. Prevents Create.
- Copy: "Configuration mismatch: Selected model requires an instance with >32GB GPU memory. Choose a larger instance class or pick a smaller model."
- CTA: "Choose compatible instance" (primary) and "Auto-select compatible settings" (secondary) — the latter runs heuristics and updates settings but marks them as user-editable.

C) Pinning conflict at rollout (informational)
- UI state: info pill in Review step if endpoint is being created from an earlier pinned version.
- Copy: "This workspace already has a pinned endpoint for model v2.3. Creating another pinned endpoint may increase maintenance. Consider using unpinned endpoints for experimental routes."
- CTA: "Proceed anyway" / "Use unpinned". Also show link to org policy docs.

D) Permanent failure (model artifact missing or corrupted)
- UI state: modal on Create failure with error code and copy.
- Copy: "Model artifact not found: the model version you selected was removed from the catalog. To recover, select a different version or unpin the endpoint to use the latest compatible model."
- Recovery actions (buttons): "Select another version" / "Unpin and continue" / "Contact workspace admin".

Edge cases and UX considerations:
- If user toggles pin AFTER creation, we need clear expectations. Post-creation pin toggle should require a confirmation explaining that toggling to pinned will snapshot a model id. Conversely unpinning should warn that subsequent model upgrades may change outputs.
- Rollout scenario: when a model rollout is ongoing (canary -> main), pinned endpoints should show a small warning in the console but not block inference.
- Multi-model endpoints: display clear mapping of route->model; disallow partial pinning that would break compatibility unless user explicitly confirms.
- Teams with policy locks: if org-level policy forbids unpinned endpoints in prod, present a small lock icon and tooltipped reason; make the Create button show "Blocked by org policy" and a link to request an exception.

Microcopy examples (candidate strings):
- Main CTA on Review: "Create endpoint" — tooltip: "Creates an endpoint that can be used immediately. Unpinned endpoints may receive model updates."
- Pin checkbox label: "Pin model version (stable outputs)" — helper: "Locks to a specific artifact id; recommended for production."
- Fallback policy label: "Fallback priorities" — options: "Use cheaper-compatible model", "Use latest-compatible", "Fail-fast". Small subcopy: "Fallbacks help maintain availability when capacity is constrained."
- Creation success toast: "Endpoint ready — you can now route requests to /endpoints/<name>" (link to endpoint page).
- Small inline help: "Why recommend this instance?" -> "Because this instance meets the model's GPU memory and latency profile, and keeps cost in the expected band."

Telemetry & observability hooks (for eng to implement):
- Emit events for: pin-toggle (user id + endpoint id + from->to), create_attempt, create_success/failure (with error code), preflight_override (user accepted auto-fix), fallback_policy_selected.
- Surface the preflight status on endpoint detail page with a timestamp and resolution steps.

Acceptance criteria (MVP):
- Users can create endpoint with model selection and optional pinning.
- Preflight compatibility panel informs and prevents obvious incompatibilities.
- All three transient/compatibility/permanent error states have copy and CTAs implemented.
- Telemetry events for create and pin actions are emitted.

Backlog / prioritization notes (rough):
- P0: Implement preflight checks + blocking incompatibility copy and CTAs.
- P1: Pin toggle modal + post-creation pin/unpin flow.
- P2: Fallback policy UI in Review step.
- P3: Org-policy locks + exception request flow.

Open questions (for sync):
- How should default fallback be set for trial accounts vs enterprise? (security implication + cost)
- Do we auto-select compatible instance classes or just offer suggestions? If auto-select, what happens to telemetry and user education?
- Should we surface recommended quantization automatically for unpinned endpoints?

Sketch references and next steps:
- See attached rough sketches in Slack #console-ux (thread ts: 1689302345) — we should convert the small preflight matrix into a single responsive component.
- Next: schedule 1-hr sync with eng (Samira, Liam) to align on telemetry schema and failure codes. After that, convert these wireframe notes to Figma frames and run a short 5-user usability check internally.

Notes to self (work-in-progress):
- Keep copy short; avoid technical jargon in banners. If error requires admin action, call out the role explicitly ("workspace admin").
- Try two variations of the pinning tooltip in the next PR: one concise (1 sentence) and one example-based (2 sentences + quick example).

Document version: draft v0.9 — expect copy to iterate after design review.
